item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 minimalist motion-graphics advertisement for the fictional planning app DayNest. Exactly THREE scenes, each precisely 3 seconds, separated by clean hard cuts at 3.0s and 6.0s. Locked straight-on camera, flat vector design, warm cream background and forest-green / soft sage-green shapes. Simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes only. No people, photographs, device screens, or detailed UI. Large crisp centered green typography with generous margins. Each scene displays ONE exact line, continuously readable throughout its 3-second scene, with no text animation that obscures letters. EXACT TEXT AND TIMING: Scene 1, 0.0–3.0 seconds: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' A simple blank calendar outline with empty grid cells gently settles below the text and a green checkmark pops in. Scene 2, 3.0–6.0 seconds: 'Plan your day in one place.' Simple blank calendar squares align neatly with one checkmark, below the text. Scene 3, 6.0–9.0 seconds: 'Try DayNest today.' A large green checkmark resolves beside a simple blank calendar icon below the text; end on a stable frame. Render the quoted text exactly as written, preserving capitalization, spaces, and punctuation, but do not render the quotation marks. Each line appears only in its own scene, never simultaneously with another line. No other visible words or characters anywhere: no separate brand logo text, no weekdays, month names, calendar numbers, labels, captions, watermarks, decorative lettering or background text. Calendar grids must remain completely blank. No audio track, no music, speech, or sound effects. Calm, clean, polished cream-and-green 2D animation.
